patterns: What are the symptoms of COVID
How do I know if I have coronavirus
What symptoms should I look for
responses: Common symptoms include fever, cough, tiredness, loss of taste or smell, and sore throat. See WHO info at https://www.who.int
If you have symptoms, stay home and get tested if possible. More details: https://www.who.int
Seek medical advice if you have difficulty breathing or chest pain. Official guidance: https://www.who.int

patterns: How can I protect myself from coronavirus
What should I do to stay safe
responses: Wash hands often, avoid close contact, wear a mask, and clean frequently touched surfaces. WHO advice: https://www.who.int
Stay up to date with vaccinations and avoid crowded indoor spaces when possible. See WHO prevention tips at https://www.who.int
If you are sick, stay home and isolate from others. Official guidance: https://www.who.int

patterns: Do I need a COVID test
responses: COVID tests are available at clinics, pharmacies, and testing centers. WHO testing guidance: https://www.who.int
If you have symptoms or were exposed, take a rapid antigen or PCR test as recommended. See WHO info at https://www.who.int
Follow local health guidelines for testing and isolation. More: https://www.who.int
Vaccination is one of the best ways to reduce your risk of severe COVID. See WHO vaccine info at https://www.who.int
Follow the latest guidance in your region for primary doses and boosters. WHO link: https://www.who.int
Ask a healthcare provider if you are unsure about vaccination. More info: https://www.who.int
